note: innerHTML-style sinks allowed per file, with the source of the markup. Prefer textContent or DOM APIs; a new sink needs a line here.

site/gallery/gallery.js.source: Markup assembled from gallery.data.js (generated from the element and sample folders) with every dynamic value passed through esc().

js/sanitized-html.js.source: The one shared sink (fillSanitizedHtml) for markup a build step has already sanitised: pk-doc-page's article body (App framework tracker #346, step 7, issue #353) and, until the guides page moves onto that page type (step 11, issue #357), site/guides/page.js's own guide HTML, generated by tools/guides.mjs from the repo's Markdown files (tools/markdown.mjs escapes raw HTML and every attribute value, and refuses unsafe addresses). Parsed inert in a <template>, then imported; moved here from site/guides/page.js so there is exactly one place this pattern is implemented (net zero: that file's own sink is gone).

site/gallery/preview.js.source: One sink: the pattern or layout fragment picked by id from gallery.data.js (generated from the repo's own sample files); nothing from the query string is interpolated.

modules/code-explorer/element.js.source: One helper (fill) writes every piece of the explorer's markup: provider data (file paths, code lines, search hits) is escaped with esc() before interpolation and tokens are wrapped in fixed spans.

modules/scorecard/scorecard.js.source: One helper (fromHtml) parses the module's own fixed markup and the ranked table built from finding text and scores, every dynamic value passed through esc(). The framework sections build nodes with the DOM and use no markup strings.

modules/scorecard/measure.js.source: The scale test renders a generated table of fixed sample rows (numbers only) to time layout; nothing from outside reaches it.

site/gallery/elements-view.js.source: The element's own example markup from its meta file, and markup the reader types into the playground (their own page, their own input).

js/element-inspector.js.source: Reads only: the live element's outerHTML is shown as text in a code block (textContent); nothing is parsed or written as markup.

js/element.js.source: The element class's static template: markup authored in elements/<name>/<name>.html and inlined by the build, parsed once into a template element.

samples/templates/chrome.js.source: Static example-page chrome from constants; page title and crumbs come from the page's own script.

tools/audit/families/s-rules.mjs.source: S5's own rule text: the words innerHTML/outerHTML/insertAdjacentHTML appear only as detector regex sources, a doc comment and a fix message string that names the sinks it flags in a consumer's code; this file never assigns to any of them.

elements/frame/frame.js.source: pk-frame is the one place that writes an iframe's srcdoc (issue #523); the scanner's html-sink rule matches innerHTML/outerHTML/insertAdjacentHTML only, so srcdoc scores 0 hits here, but it is the same kind of sink and is documented for the same reason: the string is host-authored data rendered by the sandboxed frame's own document, never parsed into this page.
